Projects.title: Featured Projects
Projects.subtitle: A curated selection of applications and service systems I have designed and implemented.

project-1.title: DevStore Dashboard
project-1.description: A comprehensive e-commerce admin panel featuring real-time sales analytics and inventory management.
project-1.longDescription: DevStore Dashboard is a fully-featured administrative portal built for online merchants. It delivers actionable sales insights, dynamically aggregates product statistics, and allows complete inventory management through a secure interface.
features: Real-time revenue and sales charts using Recharts.
Inventory tracking with low-stock automatic alert tags.
Secure user role authentication and role-based actions.
Dynamic tables with pagination, sorting, and text filter queries.
project-1.challenges: Aggregating large datasets of transactions on the server caused noticeable layout shifts and slow response times on slow connections.
project-1.solutions: Implemented server-side pagination and caching with Prisma, and added React Suspense skeletons to keep page transitions instant and smooth.

project-2.title: PulseFit Tracker
project-2.description: A cross-platform mobile application designed to track fitness goals, workouts, and daily nutrition.
project-2.longDescription: PulseFit is a modern mobile tracker helping health-conscious users plan workouts, count calories, and visualize weekly achievements. It operates smoothly offline and synchronizes data to a backend once connection is restored.
features: Custom routine builders with automatic exercise timers.
Nutrition scanning logging and daily calorie trackers.
Offline database support storing local data in SQLite.
Weekly analytics reporting via beautiful native layout charts.
project-2.challenges: Synchronizing SQLite offline logs with remote API databases while resolving timestamp and data ordering conflicts.
project-2.solutions: Created a robust queue system that registers state mutations, sorting and resolving actions chronologically with exponential retry backoffs.

project-3.title: GatewayX Microservice API
project-3.description: An API gateway microservice configured with rate limiting, logging, and CORS request dispatchers.
project-3.longDescription: GatewayX functions as a centralized gateway routing requests between frontend layers and back-end microservices. It features custom token parsing, high-speed rate-limiting, and comprehensive logging pipelines.
features: Sub-millisecond token authentication checks powered by Redis caching.
IP-based and account-based rate limiting configurations.
Centralized CORS, security headers, and request forwarding pipelines.
Structured log pipelines streaming warning flags and error logs.
project-3.challenges: Handling thousands of concurrent authorization requests created database connection bottlenecks.
project-3.solutions: Offloaded token validations to an in-memory Redis store, resolving cache hits instantly and reducing backend database queries by 85%.
